seoTitle: Salary Calculator - Hourly to Annual Pay Converter
metaDescription: Free online salary calculator. Easily convert your pay between hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, and annual amounts based on your work schedule.
intro: Want to know how much your hourly wage equals per year? Or what your annual salary breaks down to per week? Our Salary Calculator does the math for you instantly. Understanding your true earning potential is the first step toward achieving your financial goals, whether that involves saving for a down payment, paying off debt, or simply building a comfortable emergency fund. Our tool provides a straightforward way to calculate your earnings without the need for complex spreadsheets or manual calculations. Start making informed decisions about your career and financial future today with complete clarity. By getting a comprehensive view of your income, you can better manage your budget.
whatIs: A salary calculator is a tool that converts your income across different pay periods. It takes your current pay rate and work schedule to show you exactly how much you earn hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, and annually.
howToUse: Select your Pay Frequency (e.g., Annually, Hourly, Monthly).
Adjust your Work Schedule (Hours per Week and Days per Week) if it differs from the standard 40 hours / 5 days.
Instantly view your salary breakdown across all timeframes.
howItWorks: The tool first converts your inputted amount into a baseline annual salary. For example, if you input an hourly wage, it multiplies that by your hours per week, and then by 52 weeks in a year. From that annual baseline, it divides to find the monthly (÷12), weekly (÷52), and daily rates.
workedExample: If you earn $25 an hour and work 40 hours a week: Your weekly pay is $1,000. Your annual salary (52 weeks) is $52,000. Your monthly salary (divided by 12) is roughly $4,333.
resultInterpretation: The Salary Breakdown shows gross pay (before taxes and deductions). 'Bi-Weekly' means getting paid every two weeks (26 paychecks a year). 'Semi-Monthly' means getting paid twice a month (24 paychecks a year).
useCases: Job Offers: Comparing an hourly job offer to a salaried job offer.
Budgeting: Finding out your exact monthly income from an annual salary.
Freelancing: Figuring out what hourly rate to charge to hit a target annual income.
tipsAndLimitations: This calculator provides gross income figures (before taxes). Your actual take-home pay will be lower.
The calculation assumes you are paid for 52 weeks a year. If you take unpaid time off, your actual annual earnings will be less.

faq.question: What is the difference between Bi-Weekly and Semi-Monthly?
faq.answer: Bi-weekly means you get paid every two weeks (usually on a Friday), resulting in 26 paychecks a year. Semi-monthly means you get paid twice a month (e.g., the 1st and 15th), resulting in 24 paychecks a year.

faq.question: How many work hours are in a year?
faq.answer: A standard full-time work year is typically calculated as 2,080 hours (40 hours/week * 52 weeks).

disclaimer: This tool calculates gross pay for estimation purposes only. It does not account for income taxes, benefits, or other deductions.
